summary: Coordinate wedding budgets, suppliers, guest travel and event-day plans. Explore the five-day destination wedding planning course.
lede: Destination wedding planning connects venues, travel, suppliers and guest needs in one workable event plan. For wedding planners, venue coordinators and destination event staff, this course develops practical skills to create a couple brief and RACI matrix, map a critical path, manage guest information and prepare contingency plans and an event-day run of show.
audienceIntro: This intermediate course is designed for professionals who already coordinate weddings, hospitality or destination services and need to manage the connected planning tasks behind a destination celebration.
modules: Run of Show and Event Review
prerequisites: Prior experience coordinating weddings, hospitality events or destination services is recommended. No coding or programming is required. A laptop with spreadsheet access is useful for the budget-tracking exercises.
